title: 11 狐诡士12 白鬼13 副统领
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：等到谢平平买完东西的时候，贺堪已经重新回到原地。
“喏，先吃点肉垫着，这几天还有的忙呢。”
谢平平手中拿着油纸包好的卤肉，切好的，还给了一包给贺堪，顺便，还拿了两个馒头给他，示意他快点吃。
“谢了。”
贺堪接过肉和馒头，也不讲究，直接学着谢平平在街市上就开吃了。
还别说，这肉一入口浓香厚重，软糯有嚼劲，更不用说这块卤肉肉中带筋，吃的贺堪忍不住加快速度。
“现在是傍晚，阴气压着人气，咱们走过这么多户，符箓亮都没亮一个，恐怕那只狐坟子早就披着人气溜出城了。”
谢平平与贺堪继续走，皱着眉头。
“而且天色这么晚，入夜之后，墓园那里，即使是咱们监天司诡士也不会过去。”
夜晚，是诡物的世界。
特别是荒郊野岭的，还是墓园，在那里，诡物得天独厚。
“只能明天再去看看了。”
贺堪也正有此意，他是想弄清楚这一切，也想尽快找出那只狐坟子，可晚上的墓地不是开玩笑的，原身的记忆中，到了傍晚，小贺村每家每户连门都不会出，入夜就会关灯。
贺堪十分知晓厉害，开口道。
谢平平也正有此意。
两个人对视一眼，纷纷皱起眉头，他们决定回去后继续商谈一番，明天早上再出发前往大启城十里外的墓园，一探究竟。
两人路过监天司的时候。
监天司的门房覃老头正在从小屋里面出来，看见他们两人眼睛一亮，笑眯眯的打招呼：“谢大人，贺大人，这是任务完成回来了？”
贺堪有些意外对方竟然叫出了自己的名字，所以他的名字到底被李司士与邹平司跟多少人说过了？
“是啊，你也下值了？”

谢平平习以为常的招招手，随后有气无力的道：“任务可没呢，遇到个棘手的狐坟子，感知到我们的气息就跑到城外，明天又要跑到城外去抓他。”
覃老头是个样貌看起来十分慈善的老头，笑起来十分和气，身量不高，听着谢平平的话，他点点头安抚道：“辛苦辛苦了，谢大人明天定能抓到那狐坟子。”
说完这话，覃老头已经将小屋的门锁上，转身，向两人告辞，转身往街市方向走去。
谢平平目送覃老头离去的背影消失，收回目光，一转头就看见贺堪皱起的眉头。
谢平平笑着说：“还在思考那只狐坟子的事呢？”
“没有，刚刚那位是？”
贺堪转过神，问了一句。
“是监天司看门的覃老头，按照常理讲，咱们监天司行兵这么多，大多数都是有诡力的，怎么可能需要有人看门，只是这老头家里有些关系，这才能过来。”
谢平平与贺堪一边往院子的方向走，一边开口解释：“邹老大怜他孤老无依，也就没有强烈反对，这人就算是监天司的门房了。”
“索性他也乖觉，知道有些东西不该知晓的就不知道。”
“覃老头记性十分好，基本看过一眼的东西都忘不掉，大概是曾在哪里听过你的名字吧，叫出来也不算稀奇。”
贺堪挑挑眉，对于谢平平的解释不予置否。
回到院子。
两个人因为在街市上用过晚食的缘故，腹中还算饱，便都洗洗上床准备睡觉。
窗外。
天色已暗。
贺堪躺在床上看着窗外的天色，床边桌子上放着一盏昏黄的油灯，时不时发出噼啪的响声，贺堪正准备从怀中将测诡符与清气符拿出来放在枕头底下的时候，他突然像是想起了什么，连忙直起身将衣服穿好。
贺堪上下看了下自己，确认没有任何不妥当的，这才匆匆推门出去。
又过了好一会儿，贺堪这才拿着一物回来，贺堪将这物放在自己床边，这才重新安心睡下。
夜深。

屋里的油灯早已经吹灭。
外面的院子里夜色沉沉，树影重重，趁着夜色，一只矮小瘦弱，尖吻獠牙的黑影熟门熟路的来到贺堪的房门，它伸出细长的五爪，轻轻的拨动门，推开了门。
这只怪异野兽黑影来到贺堪床边，它尖细的长吻轻轻张开，一双碧色的眼睛贪婪的看着床上熟睡的黑发青年。
白天看见这只血食的时候，它就知道绝对血气旺盛，现在近了一看，果然血气熨人，光是看着都感觉舒服，也不知道吃了会如何。
“——”
content_en:
: By the time Xie Pingping finished shopping, He Kan had already returned to where he was.
"Here, let's eat some meat first, I'm still busy these days."
Xie Pingping held the braised pork wrapped in oil paper and cut it into pieces, and gave a pack to He Kan. By the way, he also gave him two steamed buns to signal him to eat quickly.
"Thanks."
He Kan took the meat and steamed buns without being too particular and started eating them just like Xie Pingping did in the market.
Not to mention, the meat is rich and fragrant in the mouth, soft and chewy, not to mention that the braised pork has tendons in it, so I can't help but speed up the meal.
"It is evening now, and the gloomy atmosphere suppresses the popularity. We have passed through so many houses, and none of the talismans have lit up. I am afraid that the fox has long since slipped out of the city wearing the popularity."
Xie Pingping and He Kan continued walking, frowning.
"And it's getting so late. After nightfall, even our wardens from the Tiantian Division will not go to the cemetery."
Night is a world of strange things.
Especially in the wilderness, there are cemeteries, where strange things are abundant.
"I can only go and see it tomorrow."
He Kan also had this intention. He wanted to understand all this and find the fox grave as soon as possible, but the cemetery at night was no joke. In the original memory, in the evening, every household in Xiaohe Village would not even leave the door, and would turn off the lights at night.
He Kan knew the power very well and said.
Xie Pingping also had this intention.
The two people looked at each other and frowned. They decided to continue the discussion after going back and set off to the cemetery ten miles away from Daqi City tomorrow morning to find out.
When the two of them passed by Jian Tiansi.
Old Qin, the concierge of Jian Tiansi, was coming out of the hut. His eyes lit up when he saw the two of them, and he greeted them with a smile: "Master Xie, Master He, are you back from completing the mission?"
He Kan was a little surprised that the other party actually called his name, so how many people had his name been told by Li Sishi and Zoupingsi?
"Yeah, you've taken the risk too?"
Xie Pingping waved as usual, and then said weakly: "There is no mission. I encountered a troublesome fox. He sensed our breath and ran outside the city. Tomorrow, we will run outside the city to catch him."
Old Man Qin was an old man who looked very charitable. He smiled very kindly and was not tall. Hearing Xie Pingping's words, he nodded and comforted him: "Thank you for your hard work. Mr. Xie will definitely catch that fox grave tomorrow."
After saying this, Old Man Qin had already locked the door of the hut, turned around, said goodbye to the two of them, and walked towards the market.
Xie Pingping watched Old Man Tan disappear as he left. He looked away, and when he turned around, he saw He Kan's frowning brows.
Xie Pingping smiled and said, "Are you still thinking about that fox grave?"
"No, who was that just now?"
He Kan turned around and asked.
"It's the old man Qin who is guarding the gate of Supervisor Tiansi. According to common sense, our Supervisor Tiansi has so many troops, and most of them are cunning. How could we need someone to guard the gate? It's just that this old man has some connections in his family, so he can come here."
Xie Pingping and He Kan explained as they walked toward the courtyard: "Boss Zou felt sorry for him being lonely and helpless, so he didn't object strongly. This person can be regarded as the concierge of Jian Tiansi."
"He is simply obedient. He knows that there are some things that he shouldn't know, so he doesn't know."
"Old man Qin has a very good memory. He can't forget almost anything he has seen. He must have heard your name somewhere before. It's not unusual to call him out."
He Kan raised his eyebrows and refused to comment on Xie Pingping's explanation.
Return to the yard.
The two of them were still full because they had eaten dinner at the market, so they washed up and went to bed to prepare for bed.
outside the window.
It's getting dark.
He Kan was lying on the bed looking at the sky outside the window. There was a dim oil lamp on the table beside the bed, which made a crackling sound from time to time. He Kan was about to take the magic talisman from his arms.When he took out the Qing Qi Talisman and put it under the pillow, he suddenly seemed to remember something and quickly stood up and put on his clothes.
He Kan looked at himself up and down to make sure there was nothing inappropriate, and then hurriedly opened the door and went out.
After a while, He Kan came back with something. He Kan placed the object next to his bed, and then fell asleep peacefully again.
Late at night.
The oil lamp in the house had long been blown out.
It was dark at night in the yard outside, with heavy shadows from the trees. Taking advantage of the darkness, a short, thin, black figure with sharp snouts and fangs came to He Kan's door familiarly. It stretched out its five slender claws, gently opened the door, and pushed it open.
The shadow of this weird beast came to He Kan's bedside. Its long, thin kiss gently opened, and its green eyes looked greedily at the sleeping black-haired young man on the bed.
When I saw this blood food during the day, I knew it was definitely full of blood. Now that I looked closer, it was indeed full of blood. I felt comfortable just looking at it, and I didn't know what would happen if I ate it.
"——"
